newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Essex County, N.Y..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Essex County, N.Y..

text.p: Sealed bids for the above-captioned bonds will be received by the County of Essex, New York (the
offices of Squire, Sanders & Dempsey L.L.P., 350 Park Avenue, 15th Floor, New York, New York 10022 until 11:00 A.M., Prevailing Time, on

at which time and place the bids will be opened for the purchase at not less than par and accrued interest of $6,104,000 aggregate principal amount County of Essex, New York, Serial General Obligations Bonds, Series 1997, dated May 15, 1997, bearing interest payable semi-annually on May 15 and November 15 commencing May 15, 1998, and maturing on May 15 in the years and corresponding principal amounts as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

The Bonds maturing on or after May 15, 1999 are subject to redemption prior to maturity on or after May 15, 1998 pursuant to the First Call Provision, and the Bonds maturing on or after May 15, 2006 are subject to redemption prior to maturity on or after May 15, 2005 pursuant to the Second Call Provision, at the prices and on the terms more fully described in the Preliminary Official Statement and the Notice of Sale. Such bids will be opened in public at said time and place on said day for the purchase of the Bonds. The Bonds will be awarded with regard to whether Bonds are bid on the basis of the First Call Provision or on the basis of the Second Call Provision pursuant to the net interest cost method as to the call provision selected by the Treasurer of the County as set forth in the Notice of Sale. The Bonds are general obligations of the County and will be secured by the full faith and credit of the County, all as more fully described in the Preliminary Official Statement. The approving opinion of Squire, Sanders & Dempsey L.L.P., Bond Counsel, will be furnished to the successful bidder at the expense of the County.

Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement and the Notice of Sale and the Proposal Forms relating to the Bonds may be obtained from the Financial Advisor to the County, Fiscal Advisors & Marketing, Inc., Cicero Professional
Building, Suite 112, P.O. Box 1429, 6221 Route 31, Cicero, New York 13039 (Telephone: 315-699-7912). Additional
Official Statements may be downloaded from Fiscal Advis Marketing, Inc.'s Internet address:

http://www.fiscaladvisors.com. Each bid must be submitted on a bid form (not a photocopy thereof) contained in the Notice of Sale and Proposal Forms. The Bonds will be delivered on or about June 10, 1997.
